name: vexa
description: Send a bot to a Google Meet, Teams or Zoom call and follow the live transcript in a panel beside the chat. Works with hosted Vexa or your company's own Vexa; you sign in through its sign-in page, no API key.

vexa_url.title: Vexa address
vexa_url.description: The Vexa this plugin talks to. Keep https://api.cloud.vexa.ai for hosted Vexa; a company running its own Vexa puts its address here, for example https://vexa.example.com.

vexa_api_key.title: Vexa API key (only until your Vexa offers sign-in)
vexa_api_key.description: Leave empty when your Vexa signs you in through /mcp (OAuth). Hosted Vexa takes a key until its sign-in ships: create one at https://vexa.ai/account and paste it here.
